name: Document the renderer and the game loop as a tutorial
body: docs/renderer.md walks one frame from the game's RenderWorld to the GPU, file by file, and says where the features this renderer leaves out (shadows, materials, more lights, post-processing, instancing) would go. docs/application-and-game-loop.md explains the life cycle and the fixed-step loop. The renderer, application and loop files get tutorial comments, as the game code has (D-042). Nothing in the repository names any other engine.
